decision: Accept contextPct in EvaluateRunBudgetInput type but do not evaluate it (no matching limit field in BudgetLimits)
alternatives: Omit contextPct from the input type entirely
Add a context limit field to BudgetLimits
reasoning: The task signature listed contextPct as an optional input, but the budget matrix defines no context-window ceiling in Phase 1. Kept it in the input surface for forward-compat while evaluating only the three dimensions with defined limits (wall-time, tool-calls, cost).
risk: A caller may pass contextPct expecting it to influence the verdict; it is silently ignored until a limit is added in a later phase.
reviewHint: Confirm contextPct being accepted-but-unused is acceptable for Phase 1 scope

decision: Gate sidecar staleness on updatedAt ?? lastFiredAt; accept value when no timestamp present
alternatives: gate strictly on updatedAt only (would always omit the real tool-call sidecar which carries lastFiredAt)
reasoning: Real context-refresher-state.json carries lastFiredAt not updatedAt; Phase-2 luca-usage-signal.json will carry updatedAt. Strict updatedAt gating would permanently omit the tool-call dimension; the fallback keeps it functional while honoring the 5-min window.
risk: A future sidecar omitting both timestamps could use a stale value best-effort; bounded since tool-call is advisory and never the sole halt trigger
reviewHint: Confirm updatedAt ?? lastFiredAt staleness fallback matches the Phase-2 usage-signal sidecar contract
